segments.title: 第153章 生日快樂
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 153 Happy Birthday

Watching Li Luo wrap a band-aid around Ying Chanxi's finger, Xu Youyu curiously sized up the balls of yarn and the nearly finished scarf on the bed, and couldn't help but exclaim:

"Xixi, you're so amazing, you actually know how to knit scarves?"

"I learned this from Auntie Lin when I was little." Ying Chanxi said, lowering her head shyly, "I haven't knitted in a long time, so I'm a little rusty."

"So this is a birthday present for Li Luo, right?" Xu Youyu said, "No wonder you were in such a hurry to come back."

Ying Chanxi was a little embarrassed: "I originally thought I'd have enough time, but the competition class was too busy. I've been staying up late rushing to finish it, I almost didn't make it."

Xu Youyu nodded in understanding. Then she walked out of the bedroom, brought a Doraemon plushie from the living room, and handed it to Ying Chanxi with a smile: "I didn't even know today was Li Luo's birthday."

"But it just so happens that I was planning to buy gifts for you two, and they arrived today."

"You can have this. I see you quite like these kinds of plushies."

"Um..." Ying Chanxi blinked, looking at the Doraemon plushie in front of her, momentarily at a loss for words.

She looked at Li Luo, then at the Pikachu on her headboard that Yan Zhusheng had given her, and finally looked back at the Doraemon. She took it and hugged it to her chest, "Thank you, Senior. I like it a lot."

Seeing Ying Chanxi accept the gift, Xu Youyu nodded in satisfaction. She then stood up and patted her bottom: "I'm going to take a shower then. You two take your time."

After watching Xu Youyu leave the room, Li Luo turned his gaze back to Ying Chanxi: "Is your hand okay? Are you going to keep knitting the scarf?"

"It's fine." Ying Chanxi picked up the knitting needles again, planning to quickly finish the scarf.

Li Luo didn't disturb her further, just sat quietly on the edge of the bed, watching her knit from the side.

Under the warm yellow light, strands of hair fell by Ying Chanxi's ear, outlining her soft cheeks.

Her expression was serious, her hands moving quickly. After about ten more minutes of knitting, she was almost done.

Ying Chanxi glanced at the time. It was just a little past nine, so she breathed a small sigh of relief.

"Done!"

After finishing the final touches, without even taking the time to clean up the balls of yarn on her bed, Ying Chanxi eagerly hugged the scarf and showed it to Li Luo: "Try it on! See if it fits."

As she said this, Ying Chanxi didn't hand the scarf to Li Luo. Instead, she put it on for him herself, carefully wrapping it around his neck, letting the ends hang down, one long and one short.

Dressed in his school uniform jacket, Li Luo's entire temperament and aura softened after putting on the warm red scarf.

He looked warm and cozy just by sight.

"Mm... it's warm." Li Luo smiled, stroking the scarf with his fingers, feeling its texture, "I like it a lot."

"I'm glad you like it." Hearing Li Luo's words, a smile blossomed on Ying Chanxi's face. She felt that all her recent efforts had been worth it.

Especially after seeing Li Luo wear her scarf, she was filled with a sense of accomplishment. That feeling of inner peace and satisfaction brought her a calming joy.

It was like a puppy marking its territory.

"By the way." Ying Chanxi suddenly thought of something and asked curiously, "Senior said she also gave you a gift. What did she get you?"

"A keyboard." Li Luo stood up and walked out of the bedroom.

Ying Chanxi quickly followed him to the desk in the living room, where she immediately saw two keyboards sitting on the desk.

One red and one blue, very eye-catching.

"Why do these two keyboards look so similar?"

"She said they were custom keyboards." Li Luo said, "Apparently, they're from a recent release by a studio in the industry that specializes in customizations. There are only three thousand of them in the world."

"Is that so." Ying Chanxi didn't know anything about keyboards, but she could tell it was probably quite precious, and she pursed her lips.

Then she shifted her gaze to the shoebox on the side: "What about this? I saw you carrying it after school, but I was in a hurry to get back so I didn't ask."

"Oh, this." Li Luo opened the shoebox, which contained his old pair of shoes. He then pointed to the new pair of white sneakers by the door and said, "Sneakers from Yan Zhusheng. Also a birthday present."

"I see." Ying Chanxi narrowed her eyes slightly, looking at the keyboard from Xu Youyu, then at the sneakers from Yan Zhusheng. "Did anyone else give you a birthday present?"

"I don't think so?" Li Luo thought for a moment. Indeed, no one else had mentioned it today.

Mainly because he wasn't in the habit of celebrating his birthday himself. If people didn't take the initiative to ask, they wouldn't know when his birthday was.

Only a simpleton like Yan Zhusheng would just assume the birthday on his QQ was real without even asking. What if it was fake?

Xu Youyu's gift was a coincidence; her delivery just happened to arrive today.

Only Ying Chanxi had started preparing his gift a long time ago, and she had even made it herself.

"However, besides the scarf, I've prepared something else." Ying Chanxi came up behind Li Luo, pushed him by the shoulders to the dining table, and pressed him down into a chair.

Producing an eye mask from who knows where, Ying Chanxi helped Li Luo put it on and then instructed, "No peeking, okay?"

"I know." Li Luo said with a laugh, "Why all the mystery?"

"Don't worry about it, just wait."

Li Luo's ears perked up. He heard Ying Chanxi's footsteps moving away, seemingly towards the kitchen... hmm... the sound of the refrigerator door opening, then closing.

Did she get something?

The sound of a light switch on the wall.

Even with the eye mask on, there was still a gap at the bottom where he could see light.

At this moment, the lights in the living room dimmed, and Li Luo was plunged into complete darkness.

But soon, the sound of a lighter clicked by his ear.

Li Luo's heart stirred, and a small smile crept onto his lips.

"Time to take off the eye mask." Ying Chanxi walked up behind Li Luo and whispered in his ear.

Li Luo nodded.

The next second, Ying Chanxi removed his eye mask.

What greeted his eyes was a dim living room, and on the dining table, a birthday cake flickering with a brilliant glow.

The cake Ying Chanxi had prepared was only about the size of a palm, with two candles on top in the shape of a "1" and a "6".

It signified that Li Luo had just turned 16.

"Happy birthday to you"

"Happy birthday to you"

Ying Chanxi stood behind Li Luo, clapping her hands softly and humming the birthday song.

After she finished singing, she patted Li Luo's shoulder: "Make a wish."

"Alright." Li Luo smiled, looking at the cake and candles before him, a hint of nostalgia in his eyes.

The last time he had a birthday cake was probably back in the sixth grade.

It really was a distant memory.

He clasped his hands together and silently made a wish in his heart.

Then he opened his eyes and blew out the candles in one breath.

Ying Chanxi clapped, turned on the living room lights, and then asked curiously, "What did you wish for?"

"It won't come true if I say it. Are you sure you want to hear?"

"Then forget it, don't tell me."

After taking off the candles, Ying Chanxi picked up the plastic cake knife and cut the cake into three pieces: "Let's leave a piece for Senior too."

"By the way, why didn't you wait for Senior to finish her shower before doing this?"

Ying Chanxi's eyes darted away as she said casually, "I forgot. I was just too excited to celebrate your birthday."

A while later.

After Li Luo and Ying Chanxi had finished their cake, Xu Youyu walked out of the bathroom, drying her hair.

When she saw the piece of cake they had left for her, her eyes lit up: "I didn't expect to get some cake too, thanks."

"I'm going to take a shower now." After finishing her cake, Ying Chanxi grabbed her change of clothes and went into the bathroom.

Li Luo stretched at the dining table, stood up, and picked up the cyan-blue keyboard Xu Youyu had given him, heading toward his bedroom: "I'm going to try out the keyboard you gave me."

"Go on, go on." Xu Youyu waved her hand. "Happy birthday."

That night, after showering, Ying Chanxi returned to her bedroom. After tidying up the bed, she lay down to sleep.

But when she thought about the birthday gifts that Senior and Zhusheng had given Li Luo today, she couldn't help but purse her lips.

So, in the end, she turned on her side and pulled the Pikachu and Doraemon from the head of the bed into her arms.

Thump, thump, she gave them two punches.

One punch for each plushie, a fair distribution of affection.

Meanwhile, Li Luo, who was clacking away on the keyboard from Xu Youyu, suddenly received a QQ message from his editor.

Qian Zhou: Reignite, are you there? You know Yuan Wanqing?!

(End of this chapter)
